content: k3s ships Traefik as default ingress with ServiceLB exposing 80/443 on the node IP. Common homelab pattern: external reverse proxy (NPM) proxies to the Traefik LB IP; per-host routing happens in Traefik via Ingress resources, so NPM only needs to forward the host header. Swapping to ingress-nginx is possible (--disable traefik) but unnecessary. Sources: docs.k3s.io, picluster.ricsanfre.com.
